d1279.Raw_Article: 1279 Ta. karu foetus, embryo, egg, germ, young of animal; karuppai womb; karuvam foetus, embryo. Ma. karu embryo, yolk; karuntala generation. Ko. karv foetus of animal, larva of bees; pregnant (of animals). To. kef pregnant, in: kef ïr pregnant buffalo, kef nïl- to become pregnant, of animals. Ka. kandu foetus of beasts (? or with 1411 Ta. kaṉṟu). Te. karuvu foetus; (B.) kari uterus of animals; karugu an unopened ear of corn. Pa. kerba ( pl. kerbel) egg. Ga. (Oll.) karbe id. Go. (Ko.) garba egg ( Voc. 1054); (Koya Su.) garbūm id. ? Malt. káre to form as the stone or seed of a fruit. Cf. 1281 Ta. karukkāy . DED(S, N) 1074.
